{{Top|leg}}
'''Dallysin''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dallysin commented on the entry for the [[Taser stave|taser staff]] in the Datalog, relaying information that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had restricted the sale of the weapon after [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] remnants stole some from the armory docks.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
